subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

His condition began to _______________ (Ameliorate) after the trip.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Worsen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ameliorate"** means to make something better or improve a situation. (सुधारना)

 
 
• **Example: **The manager tried to ameliorate the working conditions for his employees.
 
 
 
• **"Worsen"** refers to the opposite of ameliorate, meaning to make something worse or deteriorate. (बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The heavy rain worsened the already damaged roads in the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Ameliorate'** is **'Worsen'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Worsen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Improve** (सुधारना): To make better or enhance the quality of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The new study methods helped improve her grades significantly.
 
 
 
• **Detach** (अलग करना): To separate something or remove it from its position.
 
 
• **Example:** She detached the photograph from the album carefully.
 
 
 
• **Explode** (फटना): To burst or blow up violently, often accompanied by a loud noise.
 
 
• **Example:** The firework exploded in the sky, creating a stunning visual display.
